method: Poppler PNG rendering at 1800 px; all 30 current pages inspected through 8 contact sheets; full-size anatomy guides and journey maps/milestone pages inspected separately.

findings.finding: Full-size visual review shows connector lines missing their numbered organ markers. In afatinib, the line from box5 ends at marker3 on the thigh; eye and mouth lines terminate near torso/arm rather than their markers. Matching numbers and text remain readable.
findings.recommendation: Correct v25 static connector geometry to the actual marker positions, or omit misleading connectors while retaining numbered matching; inspect full-size regenerated guide pages.
findings.resolution: All six connector endpoints visibly reach their own numbered marker on both guides; connectors appear above the anatomy image and below the numbered pins.

findings.finding: The What each check is for cards show only titles, timing and sources. The explanation and Ask / act paragraphs present in HTML are hidden in print by inherited endocrine CSS.
findings.recommendation: Restore milestone paragraphs with a v25-scoped print override, regenerate and visually recheck journeys.
findings.resolution: All milestone rationale and Ask / act paragraphs are visible on page 3 of both regenerated journeys without clipping or overlap.

findings.finding: Two substantially identical monitoring tables occupy separate landscape pages with extensive blank space.
findings.recommendation: Consider suppressing the initial duplicate summary in v25 journey print; retain the detailed sourced map and milestone explanations.
findings.resolution: Both monitoring tables retained by the release owner for completeness; text is legible and matches medicine-specific monitoring schedules.

findings.finding: Visible connector strokes cross white numerals inside numbered organ markers, especially lung marker 1 and gut marker 2. Geometry itself is correct.
findings.recommendation: Render numbered pins above connector strokes, with connectors remaining above the anatomy image, then inspect the two guides again.
findings.resolution: Final regenerated guides show all six white marker numerals cleanly above connector strokes; endpoints retain correct matching. Both pages of each guide visually rechecked.
